name: Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship

categories.label: Fellowship wins (One Ring destroyed)
categories.labelVi: Hội Nhẫn thắng (Chiếc Nhẫn bị hủy)
categories.hint: Won if the group destroys the One Ring before Frodo loses all Hope.

categories.label: Hope remaining at the end
categories.labelVi: Hope còn lại khi kết thúc
categories.hint: Read the Hope marker at game end; Frodo losing all Hope is a defeat.

winCondition: Cooperative; no points. The group wins by destroying the One Ring before Frodo loses all Hope (publisher description). Other defeat triggers (Shadow, Nazgul, haven or objective failures) and the per-game objective cards are not verified and not modelled.

endCondition.description: Ends when the Ring is destroyed (win) or Frodo loses all Hope (loss); other loss triggers unverified.

notes: family: coop. No points. The official Z-Man rulebook (BGG file 413639, ZMGPSM0101_Rulebook_English_WEB.pdf) could not be downloaded from this environment, so only the publisher-stated win and Hope-loss conditions are recorded; needs verification against the rulebook for exact end conditions and the solo adventure. 24 objectives, 13 characters (2 per player), 1-5 players per publisher.
